VERIFICATION LOG — EVIDENCE
### 2026-09-10 — worker — selected from explicit user repair request

Live production HEAD checks found the 205,050,833-byte RAM snapshot has no
Cache-Control header, while the kernel is immutable-cacheable. The service
worker excludes R2 and release bytes; the loader uses only ordinary HTTP cache
behavior for every launch. The serial output handler replaces restore status
with "boot continues" and retains the previous transfer's completed bar.
Implementation and recorded browser proof are pending.

### 2026-09-10 — worker — frozen cache/status submission

Runtime and harness head: `408422d4b319f8267071d0bd47d46c90a81e1af3`.
The diff starts at `66cf844c` and includes `af206380` plus the critic-driven
terminal-lifecycle repair. Evidence root: `evidence/omarchy-profile/boot-cache-r1/`.

- `make web-dist` passed (`build-terminal-fix.log`), producing app-shell version
  `bd110684de37`. WASM remains exactly
  `c48e9c2d9ec550c7daf4875716fef1dc729072fdfc91b805394d379bee4b9305`;
  the E5.5-T03c guest/runtime evidence boundary is unchanged.
- `node --test web/tests/boot-asset-cache.test.mjs web/tests/omarchy-startup-state.test.mjs web/tests/omarchy-seeded-loader.test.mjs web/tests/e5.5-t03e-critic.test.mjs web/tests/e5.5-t03e-critic-ui.test.mjs`
  passed 35 tests. The independent terminal-state refutation and subsequent
  promoted late-event attacks are retained in `critic.md`.
- Pristine clone: `/private/tmp/wasm-vm-omarchy-cache.P3C7j4/repo`, cloned without
  hardlinks at the frozen head. From that directory:
  `env -i PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR=/private/tmp npm_config_cache=/private/tmp/wasm-vm-omarchy-cache.P3C7j4/npm-cache make verify-E5.5-T03e OMARCHY_CACHE_EVIDENCE_DIR=/Users/blamy/Documents/Codex/wasm-vm/evidence/omarchy-profile/boot-cache-r1/cold-clone`
  exited zero, including a fresh pinned snapshot download, all 35 tests, and the
  actual no-store-server initial/reload proof. Each of the four immutable assets
  had one initial request and zero reload requests. Restore/desktop-check times
  were 4308/67309 ms initially and 3125/64514 ms on reload. Report SHA-256:
  `d327837e93981f5035ff684ff82a08c4c0c663698af34a7cf0f3252a33abb041`.
- `E5_DEMO_TASK=E5.5-T03e E5_DEMO_OUT=evidence/omarchy-profile/boot-cache-r1/demo-terminal-fix node tools/verify/e5-t18e-demo-smoke.mjs`
  passed `126 passed, 0 failed`, zero console/HTTP errors, and captured the task
  panel. `node tools/verify/omarchy-cli-regression.mjs evidence/omarchy-profile/boot-cache-r1/cli`
  passed real BusyBox boot/RPC checks. `node tools/verify/omarchy-desktop-ui.mjs`
  passed the separate synthetic desktop-versus-CLI layout/lifecycle regression
  (`ui-terminal-fix.log`); it is not guest-rendering evidence.
- `bash tools/deploy-cloudflare.sh` succeeded on its normal retry, reusing all
  exact existing R2 objects and publishing Pages deployment `2ba45d70` to
  `https://wasm-vm.pages.dev`. The first attempt's stalled unrelated Alpine
  download and rejected oversized re-upload are retained in `deploy.log`;
  `deploy-retry.log` records successful full size/SHA checks and publication.
  No R2 object was uploaded or deleted. All four published artifact manifests
  remain semantically identical to the prior production manifests
  (`production-artifact-comparison.jsonl`).
- `node tools/verify/omarchy-boot-cache.mjs 'https://wasm-vm.pages.dev/app?guest=omarchy&desktop=1#ide' evidence/omarchy-profile/boot-cache-r1/production`
  exited zero. Six no-store, uniquely queried production source files match the
  frozen dist SHA-256 values. Normal service-worker operation is retained.
  Initial restore/desktop-check were 61805/126006 ms; reload was 3408/66429 ms
  with **zero requests for the four boot artifacts**. No browser/guest errors.
  Production report SHA-256:
  `8b00c337fcba476e519f6d96ecf443eab97deb604f54dce319eeb554b5d719ff`.

The coordinator inspected all four cold-clone and all four production PNGs.
They show the actual Hyprland bar and Foot window, an honest restore-wait phase
without a stale completed progress bar, and the visible desktop after its
existing compositor check. Cache entries contain only verified compressed
release bytes, not mutable guest state. These results prove caching and startup
reporting only: post-restore input is still slow, and E5.5-T03d remains pending.
No merge or Epic 6 work was performed.

### 2026-09-10 — verifier — VERDICT: verified

- P1–P5 and P12 HELD under the focused suite and the independent promoted
  attacks: exact size/hash enforcement rejects truncated, oversized and
  same-length-corrupt streams; content hashes isolate releases; corrupt exact
  keys are evicted and verified-refetched; storage failures preserve only an
  honestly labelled, verified network boot. Deliberately disabling either the
  hash or final-size oracle made the critic test fail.
- P6–P8 HELD after the terminal-lifecycle repair at
  `408422d4b319f8267071d0bd47d46c90a81e1af3`. The actual IDE handlers reject
  late ready/desktop-ready/state/progress after done/error/halt, cancel stale
  wait generations, clear completed bars, preserve serial diagnostics, and
  permit only a new boot to reset the latch. The prior refutation is retained
  in `critic.md`; its promoted regression tests now pass.
- P9–P10 HELD at the pristine clone and production origin. Both reports bind
  the six served browser sources to the frozen clean-scoped runtime and record
  four exact content-addressed cache keys. Each immutable asset was requested
  exactly once initially and zero times on reload. The production report
  passed with SHA-256
  `8b00c337fcba476e519f6d96ecf443eab97deb604f54dce319eeb554b5d719ff`;
  remote source hashes match the frozen dist, with no browser/guest/display
  errors. Initial restore/readiness were 61805/126006 ms and reload
  3408/66429 ms.
- P11 HELD within the task boundary. The WASM remains exactly
  `c48e9c2d9ec550c7daf4875716fef1dc729072fdfc91b805394d379bee4b9305`;
  the real CLI regression passed and the built demo recorded 126 passed, 0
  failed. The four cold-clone and four production captures preserve the same
  Hyprland/Foot pixels and honest restore-wait UI. They are not evidence of
  physical-input responsiveness, and E5.5-T03d remains unresolved.
- COVERAGE HELD. Focused/promoted tests exercise integrity, storage failure,
  source transitions and lifecycle orderings; real initial/reload runs execute
  network and cache paths; pristine-clone and production runs close the
  environment/source-binding coverage. Declarative manifest/dist stamping is
  covered by byte/hash equality rather than runtime line execution.
- SUITE: retained `web/tests/e5.5-t03e-critic.test.mjs` and
  `web/tests/e5.5-t03e-critic-ui.test.mjs` as deterministic regressions.

Evidence: `evidence/omarchy-profile/boot-cache-r1/critic.md`,
`cold-clone/report.json`, `production/report.json`, `cli/report.json`, and
`demo-terminal-fix/demo-suite.json`. Worker submission:
`c2fa94e081ad55683d38fde7d5306c7026a4bbfa`; frozen runtime:
`408422d4b319f8267071d0bd47d46c90a81e1af3`.
ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION
A fresh verifier attacks stale hashes, corrupted/truncated/oversized bodies,
storage failure, repeated reloads, deployment-version cache independence,
cross-session state leakage and false progress/readiness claims. Preserve the
unchanged guest-input acceptance; this task does not mark T03d complete.
